price_basis: Walmart public online price snapshots accessed September 24–25, 2026; quantities chosen for a larger stock-up trip, with pantry staples already at home. Not a nutritionally complete two-week meal plan or a local-store quote. Covered amounts assume sufficient matching WIC benefits. No taxes, delivery, or fees.

items.label: Large white eggs
items.rule: One dozen medium or large eggs; standard store brand.

items.label: Bananas
items.rule: Fresh fruit, charged against available produce dollars.

items.label: Baby carrots
items.rule: Plain fresh vegetables, charged against available produce dollars.

items.label: Peanut butter
items.rule: Plain creamy peanut butter in a 16–18 oz jar; no added disallowed ingredients.

items.label: 1% milk
items.rule: Plain low-fat milk; assumes matching milk allowance.

items.label: Gala apples
items.rule: Fresh fruit charged against produce dollars.

items.label: Red grapes
items.rule: Fresh fruit; rounded to nearest cent.

items.label: Chicken breasts
items.rule: Fresh chicken is outside this WIC package.

items.label: Spaghetti
items.rule: Regular refined-wheat pasta is not whole-grain pasta.

items.label: Pasta sauce
items.rule: Prepared meat-flavored sauce is not an eligible plain vegetable.

items.label: White rice
items.rule: White rice is not a WIC whole grain; brown rice is the eligible rice category.
